slides.heading: 5 rules for posts that actually travel
slides.subtitle: Reach is a craft, not an accident.

slides.heading: Earn the first two seconds
slides.body: Nobody decides to read your post. They decide to stop scrolling. Those are different decisions, and only the second one is yours to win.

slides.heading: One idea per slide
slides.body: If a slide needs the word "also", it is two slides. Splitting costs you nothing and buys the reader a place to breathe.

slides.heading: Be specific or be skipped
slides.body: A number, a name, or a moment beats an adjective every time. "Faster" is a claim. "Nine seconds to two" is a reason to believe you.

slides.heading: Replace this with your own
slides.body: Every word here is editable. Change the text, switch the style, keep the layout.
